qualification.details: Lab Technician: Intermediate and Diploma/ Certified course in MLT or Equivalent, Register with paramedical board of TG Staff Nurse: GNM or B.Sc Nursing, Registered with Nursing Council for T.S. ANM: Must have passed Multi-Purpose Health Worker (Female) Training Course and Registered with Telangana State Nurses and Midwives Council, OR Intermediate Vocational Multi-Purpose Health Worker (Female) Training Course with 1-year clinical/apprenticeship training Anesthetist: MBBS with MD in Anaesthesiology or DNB in Anaesthesia from a recognized university or institution, Registered with T.S. Medical Council OBG Specialist: MBBS with PG Degree or Diploma such as MS (OBG), MD (Gynaecology), DGO, or DNB in Obstetrics & Gynecology, Registered with T.S. Medical Council Senior Dots Plus TB HIV: Bachelor Degree or recognized Sanitary Inspector’s course, Certificate course of computer operation (Min. 2 months), Permanent 2-Wheeler Driving License OT Technician: Diploma in Operation Theatre Technology (DOTT) or Diploma in Medical Sterilization Management and OT Technology, Degree: B.Sc. in Operation Theatre Technology or BOTT, Registered with Telangana Paramedical Board

Presidential Orders and SC-ST reservation rules

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DMHO Nalgonda Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://nalgonda.telangana.gov.in/. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 03-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the District Medical and Health Office Nalgonda (DMHO Nalgonda) under the National Health Mission framework in the state of Telangana.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in DMHO Nalgonda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 24 vacancies available across various healthcare and medical positions including Staff Nurse, ANM, Lab Technician, and Specialist medical posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The applications must be submitted through offline mode. Candidates need to download the form, fill it out, and send it by post or submit it in person.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of filled-in application forms is 03-10-2026. Candidates must ensure timely submission to avoid rejection.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for DMHO Nalgonda jobs?
faq.answer: The age limit for applicants is between 18 and 44 years. Age relaxations are applicable for reserved categories as per government rules.

faq.question: Q6. What qualifications are required for Staff Nurse posts?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for Staff Nurse must possess a GNM or B.Sc Nursing qualification and must be registered with the Nursing Council for T.S.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: An application fee of Rs. 200/- is applicable for candidates applying to these posts, payable via demand draft or cash as specified.

faq.question: Q8. How will the final selection be made?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a merit list prepared out of 100 marks, where 90 marks are based on qualifying examination marks and 10 marks are awarded for age.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: You can download the notification and application form from the official website at https://nalgonda.telangana.gov.in/ or via the direct links provided.

faq.question: Q10. What is the salary range offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 15,600 to Rs. 1,00,000 per month depending on the specific post, such as Rs. 1,00,000 for Specialist doctors.
